'''George Daniel Ewing Jr.''' (born March 26, 1983) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He currently works as a scout for the [[Los Angeles Lakers]].

==College career==
A {{height|ft=6|in=3}} guard from [[Duke University]], Ewing played for four seasons at the college under coach [[Mike Krzyzewski]] from 2001 to 2005. Prior to Duke, he played for [[Willowridge High School (Houston)|Willowridge High School]] in [[Missouri City, Texas]] along with [[T. J. Ford]] and [[Ivan McFarlin]]. He was selected as a [[McDonald's All-American]] in 2001.

==Professional career==

===NBA===
Ewing was selected by the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]]'s [[Los Angeles Clippers]] in the second round (32nd overall) of the [[2005 NBA draft]]. He played with the club during two seasons, as a backup. In 127 [[regular season]] contests, he averaged 3 points, one [[Rebound (basketball)|rebound]] and one [[assist (basketball)|assist]] per game. On June 29, 2007, he was waived by the Clippers.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/ewing-singleton-062907.shtml|title=InsideHoops.com - Clippers waive Daniel Ewing, decline James Singleton option|website=www.insidehoops.com}}</ref>

===Europe===
On July 23, 2007, Ewing signed a two-year contract with the [[Russian Basketball Super League|Russian League]] club [[BC Khimki]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/news/i/14601/3735/khimki-brings-daniel-ewing-back-to-moscow|title=Khimki brings Daniel Ewing back to Moscow - Latest - Welcome to Eurocup|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141027213735/http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/news/i/14601/3735/khimki-brings-daniel-ewing-back-to-moscow |archive-date=October 27, 2014 }}</ref> After one year in Russia with Khimki, Ewing joined [[Dominet Bank Ekstraliga|Polish League]]'s [[Prokom Trefl Sopot|Asseco Prokom Sopot]] for the 2008–09 season and remained with the team until 2011.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/euroleague/news/|title=Latest News | EuroLeague|date=October 16, 2023|website=Euroleague Basketball}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

In July 2011, he signed a one-year contract with [[Azovmash Mariupol]] of Ukraine.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/ukraine/87336/azovmash-mariupol-signs-daniel-ewing.html|title=Azovmash Mariupol signs Daniel Ewing}}</ref> In December 2012, he signed with [[Beşiktaş men's basketball team|Beşiktaş]] of the [[Turkish Basketball League]] for the rest of the season.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Turkey/basketball.aspx?NewsID=297397|title=Turkey Basketball, News, Teams, Scores, Stats, Standings, Awards - eurobasket|website=www.eurobasket.com}}</ref>

In July 2013, he signed with a one-year deal [[Paris-Levallois Basket]] of the French [[LNB Pro A]].<ref>[http://www.parislevallois.com/offres/gestion/actus_549_17432-685/daniel-ewing-signe-au-pl.html Daniel Ewing signe au PL] {{in lang|fr}}</ref> On October 1, 2014, Ewing signed a six-week contract with [[Le Mans Sarthe Basket|Le Mans Sarthe]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/france/136402/le-mans-signs-daniel-ewing-to-a-six-week-contract.html|title=Le Mans signs Daniel Ewing to a six-week contract}}</ref> On October 29, 2014,  his contract with the team was extended for the rest of the season.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/france/139367/le-mans-extends-daniel-ewing-for-the-season-waives-armon-johnson.html|title=Le Mans extends Daniel Ewing for the season, waives Armon Johnson}}</ref>

On August 15, 2015, Ewing signed a one-year deal with the [[Lietuvos Krepšinio Lyga|Lithuanian]] club [[BC Neptūnas|Neptūnas Klaipėda]].<ref>{{cite news|title="Neptūno" atakoms diriguos Ewingas|url=http://www.basketnews.lt/news-88156-neptuno-atakoms-diriguos-ewingas.html#.VdHfCH3i6wI|access-date=August 17, 2015|work=Basketnews.lt|date=August 15, 2015|language=lt}}</ref>

On August 18, 2016, Ewing signed with Israeli club [[Maccabi Ashdod B.C.|Maccabi Ashdod]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/israel/209799/daniel-ewing-inks-with-maccabi-ashdod.html|title=Daniel Ewing inks with Maccabi Ashdod}}</ref> On February 22, 2017, he returned to Neptūnas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.delfi.lt/krepsinis/naujienos/neptunas-rado-pastiprinima-i-klaipeda-grizta-d-ewingas-73829376|title="Neptūnas" rado pastiprinimą: į Klaipėdą grįžta D. Ewingas|website=Krepšinis.lt}}</ref>
